Subject: Follow-up: quick recap and next steps (pricing)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Volume profile: you said pilot 2M tokens/day for 3 months, then ramp to 10M tokens/day in steady state (estimate).
- Workload mix: 70% chat-style multi-turn (avg 150 tokens in/out), 30% single-turn generation (avg 40 tokens).
- Data needs: no dedicated private deployment yet; you want hosted with IP protection and SOC 2 evidence.
- Key success criteria: latency under 300ms p50 and cost target around $X per 1M tokens (we discussed $20-25/1M as a target range).

Next steps I propose:
1) I will share a preliminary cost model and one-page invoice estimate showing unit economics and committed vs usage pricing (today).
2) If the numbers look reasonable, schedule a procurement check-in with your finance team; loop in Marissa for contract and terms.
3) Engineering sync with Dev to validate integration and perf testing plan.

I will attach an initial cost model (spreadsheet) and a one-page estimate. If you can confirm the token volume assumptions and a target $/1M tokens range we should aim for, I will iterate the model.

Thanks,
Sean

Thanks Sean,

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifications from my side:
- Pilot: correct, roughly 2M tokens/day for 90 days.
- Steady state: 8-12M tokens/day is our expected range depending on adoption; please model 10M as the central case.
- Budget: our procurement team has indicated a target invoice range for production of about $15k - $25k per month initially, but we are flexible if unit economics justify above that.
- Target unit: Aim for a blended $/1M tokens target in the $18-22 range for negotiated committed pricing.

Also, can you provide an invoice-style estimate that shows: committed vs on-demand pricing, estimated monthly bill for pilot and steady state, and a line for integration/setup credits? We will need that for our procurement review.

Best,
Alex

Subject: Acme - invoice estimate and cost model (attached)

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the details. Attached are: 1) a one-page invoice-style estimate PDF and 2) an updated cost model spreadsheet (ACME_cost_model_Q3_v2.xlsx) with the assumptions baked in. Highlights below: 

- Pilot (2M tokens/day, 90 days): estimated monthly bill = $13,600 (hosted API, committed 25% discount vs on-demand).
- Steady state (10M tokens/day): estimated monthly bill = $58,000 (committed pricing tier - additional volume discounts available at 12M+).
- Blended unit economics (central case 10M/day): $20.3 per 1M tokens (includes compute, networking, KV cache savings, and a 10% platform fee).
- On-demand blended unit: $28.5 per 1M tokens (no commitment).
- One-time integration/setup credit: we applied a $5,000 credit to the pilot invoice to accelerate procurement.

Key assumptions summarized in the spreadsheet:
- Average request length: 120 tokens in, 150 tokens out for chat (70% of traffic).
- Batching efficiency: 15% token cost savings from batching at our observed concurrency.
- Quantization: 8-bit model profile used for pilot, with possible 4-bit for later steady-state if model fidelity acceptable.

Next steps:
- If this aligns, please confirm and I will issue a formal quote for procurement and start legal redlines.
- If you want lower unit economics, we can discuss a commit increase or longer term contract to push toward $18/1M.

Attachments: 20261001_pricing_estimate.pdf (invoice-style estimate), ACME_cost_model_Q3_v2.xlsx (detailed model)

Best,
Sean Gallagher
